us-tyndall-sd-eiffel-tower-flagpole.name: Tyndall Eiffel-style flagpole
us-tyndall-sd-eiffel-tower-flagpole.label: Tyndall
us-tyndall-sd-eiffel-tower-flagpole.summary: A white lattice replica also serves as a flagpole in front of the Bon Homme County courthouse in Tyndall, South Dakota. State court history records its construction in 1898 for $200 and describes a 100-foot flagpole. Its slender frame, low arches and long bare mast distinguish it from replicas with visitor platforms.

at-st-polten-tower-on-a-small-road-besid.name: St. Pölten welcome-sign Eiffel model
at-st-polten-tower-on-a-small-road-besid.label: St. Pölten
at-st-polten-tower-on-a-small-road-besid.summary: A 2015 photograph records this white lattice model beside the railway in St. Pölten. Four straight legs support a slender shaft, with sloping platform panels, a welcome sign and a French flag. The photograph documents that appearance; the maker, construction year and present condition remain unconfirmed.

es-las-palmas-tenerife-cita-shopping-cen.name: Cita Shopping Centre decorative Eiffel tower
es-las-palmas-tenerife-cita-shopping-cen.label: Cita Shopping Centre
es-las-palmas-tenerife-cita-shopping-cen.venue: Cita Shopping Centre · Playa del Inglés
es-las-palmas-tenerife-cita-shopping-cen.summary: This decorative tower belongs to Cita Shopping Centre in Maspalomas, Gran Canaria; the earlier Tenerife attribution has been corrected. A 2017 photograph shows pale-blue solid panels, dark decorative lattice lines and thick platform outlines. Fencing and the image edge obscure the feet, so the model represents the evidenced visible section.

th-nakhon-ratchasima-terminal-21-korat.name: Terminal 21 Korat atrium Eiffel replica
th-nakhon-ratchasima-terminal-21-korat.label: Terminal 21 Korat
th-nakhon-ratchasima-terminal-21-korat.summary: A 2019 photograph records the gold-toned lattice replica in the Terminal 21 Korat atrium, with curved legs, large arches, broad platforms and a tiered upper cabin. Indoor lighting affects its photographed colour. The nearest feet are cropped, so the model excludes unseen foundations; the map's 25-metre assertion is not adopted.

th-pattaya-city-terminal-21-pattaya.name: Terminal 21 Pattaya atrium Eiffel replica
th-pattaya-city-terminal-21-pattaya.label: Terminal 21 Pattaya
th-pattaya-city-terminal-21-pattaya.summary: The replica stands in the Terminal 21 Pattaya atrium. A 2019 photograph shows its broad platform panels, dense lattice and illuminated shopping-centre sign. Blue-violet lighting in that photograph is not treated as permanent paint. Foreground objects and the image edges obscure parts of the feet; the model shows the visible section and no measured height is adopted.

ua-hrushkivka-forestry.summary: A July 2019 report describes a seven-metre Eiffel replica at Hrushkivka forestry, with three levels, a moving lift, lighting and a Ukrainian flag. Forestry staff linked the landscape project to the original tower's 130th anniversary. The map's four-metre assertion and the present condition remain unresolved.

ua-khmelnytskyi-so-called-monument-to-uk.summary: The replica stands at the Svobody and Proskurivska street junction in Khmelnytskyi. In a 2021 interview, its makers reported a height of 3.7 metres and described a collaboration between vocational-school teachers and welding students, partly funded by scrap recycling. Permanent placement was planned; present retention is a separate question.

ua-koriukivka-flower-stand-near-the-city.summary: Koryukivka installed an Eiffel-shaped flower structure in spring 2020, opposite the administrative building in the town centre. The mayor attributed the idea to local landscaping staff. It combines flower pots and arches; LED lighting was still a future plan in the report.

ua-korosten-spartak-stadium.summary: The replica at Korosten's Spartak stadium carries an electronic scoreboard. Local reporting recorded its installation in 2018, and a 2025 football article documents the same stadium tower. It is separate from the Ukrainian-emblem and embroidery-decorated tower installed in the town centre in 2021.

ua-kostopil-back-yard-of-a-private-house.summary: A January 2022 report shows a small Eiffel-shaped decoration among Christmas lights and a carriage in a private Kostopil garden. The source documents that festive display; it does not establish permanent retention.

ua-mykolayiv-kids-park-kazka.summary: The Eiffel model in Mykolaiv's Kazka children's park is near the amphitheatre. A 2020 article describes a donated six-metre model serving landscape and engineering-education purposes; a separate Shukhov water-tower model is nearby. The four-metre work made for a 2012 blacksmith festival has not been identified as this park object.

ua-nizhyn-eiffel-tower-near-a-shop-at-a-.summary: Two local welders made the replica beside Nizhyn's Silmash bus stop. A 2023 interview reports metal profile tubes, three levels and a height of 5.5 metres, using photographs and a small souvenir as references. It is separate from a later proposed tower for a central-town café.

ua-odesa-korolyova-79.summary: The Korolyova Street replica in Odesa is in a green area in front of a residential building. A travel source describes a four-metre model but supplies no maker or construction year. Factory, Osypova courtyard, Koblevska courtyard and wall-painting objects remain separate records.

ua-odesa-osypova-37.summary: A travel source describes a three-metre replica in the courtyard at 37 Osypova Street, Odesa. It also serves as a flower support in summer and is decorated by residents. Photograph dates and present retention require separate evidence.

ua-odesa-kobleska-37.summary: A travel source describes the Eiffel-shaped object in an Odesa Koblevska Street courtyard as a former advertising display that became a local feature. It supplies no reliable height or current status. Replicas on different streets have not been merged simply because they share the city.

ua-sarny-park-in-town-centre.summary: Local television reported the Sarny miniature in 2013 as a new gift to the town from the head of a metal-products company. A concrete support was provided locally. The wedding butterfly mentioned in the same report is another monument, not part of the tower.

ua-shatsk-yard-of-a-private-house.summary: The Shatsk garden maker built several versions. A 2017 article distinguishes a sold three-metre model, a six-metre version from 2013 and a 7.2-metre version from 2016. Later replacements and the version represented by the map point remain uncertain, so no single present height is adopted.

ua-zhytomyr-zarichanske-forestry.summary: Zarichanske forestry near Zhytomyr installed an Eiffel miniature before Valentine's Day as part of its educational and recreation landscape. This courtyard object is separate from the large Polytechnic tower. The exact year, dimensions and present retention remain unconfirmed.

ua-uzhgorod-a-tower-near-the-greek-catho.summary: Mikhail Kolodko's bronze miniature appeared during French cultural celebrations in early summer 2015, on an old street lamp near the cathedral in Uzhhorod. Travel sources describe a height of 16 centimetres and a weight of about one kilogram. It is a fixed public sculpture, not a handheld souvenir.

us-taylor-michigan-vinson-s-miniature-go.summary: The Library of Congress holds John Margolies's 1986 photograph of the Eiffel Tower hole at Vinson's miniature golf in Taylor, Michigan. The archive establishes historical existence. An exact removal date and a current tower location have not been established.

ua-bohorodchans-kyi-pilgrimage-center-of.name: Starunia pilgrimage-centre metal cross
ua-bohorodchans-kyi-pilgrimage-center-of.label: Starunia cross
ua-bohorodchans-kyi-pilgrimage-center-of.summary: The pilgrimage centre describes a metal cross 25 metres high and 14 metres wide, first illuminated on 19 September 2020. It is in Starunia. The source does not establish an Eiffel replica, so it remains outside the first globe collection.

ru-beliy-island-eiffel-tower-of-the-arct.name: Beliy Island wooden lighthouse
ru-beliy-island-eiffel-tower-of-the-arct.label: Beliy lighthouse
ru-beliy-island-eiffel-tower-of-the-arct.summary: The Russian Geographical Society describes a wooden lighthouse on Beliy Island and its 1936 history. Its shape is compared with the Eiffel Tower, without an explicit replication relationship. It is retained as a related structure outside the first globe collection.

tw-taoyuan-baleng-tower.name: Baling disaster-warning broadcast tower
tw-taoyuan-baleng-tower.label: Baling broadcast tower
tw-taoyuan-baleng-tower.summary: A Central News Agency report quotes the local office on the tower's disaster-warning broadcast function and an ancestral-eye design concept. Resemblance to the Eiffel Tower does not establish replication. The 29.4- and 29.5-metre assertions remain separate, and it is outside the first globe collection.

us-wellfleet-comment-replica.name: Wellfleet Eiffel-model installation proposal
us-wellfleet-comment-replica.label: Wellfleet model
us-wellfleet-comment-replica.summary: A 2023 article distinguishes a stored 21-foot model, a rejected 2020 proposal of nearly 28 feet including its base, and an approved 2023 proposal of 21 feet 3 inches. Installation still required a building-inspector permit. The sources do not establish installation at the proposed site.
